main_body: repeating ground terrain patch with fern/foliage tufts
evidence: This is a terrain ground patch ('terrain' kind), not a standing object. The entire 4x3 tile area represents a horizontal ground plane with prehistoric fern tufts seen from above.

style.evidence: The prehistoric ground tile uses 5 distinct green tones plus an amber accent to render detailed fern tufts, dark foliage clumps, and subtle ground speckle, matching or exceeding the texture density and shading depth of the Beodeul grass reference without black outlines or large flat fills.
